start:
@startuml
actor Customer
actor Member
usecase "Place Order" as UC1
usecase "Track Order" as UC2
usecase "Pay" as UC3
usecase "Cancel Order" as UC4
rectangle "Online Shop" {
  UC1
  UC3
}
Customer -- UC1
UC1 ..> UC3 : <<include>>
@enduml

@startuml
actor Customer
actor Member

uml-pg-tool-status.text: Click on the diagram to add a Use Case. Press Esc to cancel.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Use Case — UC":
  - heading "Use Case — UC" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Identifier
  - textbox "Identifier": UC
  - text: Display label
  - textbox "Display label": UC
  - text: Highlight color (#hex or name)
  - textbox "Highlight color (#hex or name)"
  - paragraph: Press Delete to remove. Press F2 to focus the name. Drag to reposition.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
